I’m on the Professional subscription, paying the highest tier, and I still have to deal with a very limited credit system for AI tools. Credits expire every week and don’t roll over, so I’m constantly watching the counter instead of just creating. For a pro‑level paid plan, a hard credit cap feels ridiculous. If I’m paying monthly at the top tier, I should have unlimited or at least very generous access to the AI features, not be throttled like a free user.[apple

Rating: ⭐️ (1/5 - Only because zero isn't an option)
I'm writing this so hopefully, I can save someone else the massive headache and wallet drain this "AI" app caused me. Instories is advertised as the magic bullet for story creation, but it's nothing more than a glitchy, over-priced subscription trap.
The Bait-and-Switch Subscription Nightmare
The absolute worst part of this app is the monetization.
• Deceptive Trial/Immediate Charge: I signed up for what I thought was a free trial, and BAM! I was immediately hit with an astronomical annual charge. The price they show in the ad/store listing seems to differ wildly from the amount they actually charge. It felt like a deliberate scam to get a full-year payment before I could even test the stability of the app.
• Customer Support Ghosting: Trying to get a refund or even an explanation was a joke. I received canned, useless "bot responses" with links to generic articles. When an app crashes this often, you need human support, not an unhelpful FAQ.
The "App" Experience: Slow, Clunky, and Broken
The quality of the app itself is even more frustrating than the billing issues.
• Crashes and Progress Loss: The app constantly freezes, lags, and crashes mid-edit. I lost hours of work because it would just quit out of nowhere. For a paid service, this level of instability is unacceptable.
• Slow Template Loading: "Forever" is the only word to describe how long it takes for templates to load. You spend more time staring at a loading spinner than actually designing.
• Useless AI/Templates: The templates are not intuitive. Trying to insert your own photos or videos is a battle. They don't fit right, the crop is off, and you can't arrange elements the way you want. What's the point of a template if you have to rebuild it from scratch? The supposed "AI" seems to do nothing but auto-generate a mess.
• Lost Features Post-Update: Some updates seem to make the app worse! I've seen others complain that the "old version was much better," with the new one being full of "glitches." It seems like they prioritize adding questionable new features over fixing critical bugs.
Final Verdict
Do yourself a favor and stick to a reliable, stable editor even a free one. Instories is an unreliable, clunky mess with a predatory subscription model. I paid a premium price for a malfunctioning product and terrible customer service. Hard pass. Do NOT download or buy this app.
